title: 2006 AMC 10B 16
statement: Leap Day, February \(29,\) \(2004,\) occurred on a Sunday. On what day of the week will Leap Day, February \(29,\) \(2020,\) occur?

solutions.text:
From one Leap Day to the next is \(3\cdot365+366=1461\) days, and \(1461\equiv 5\pmod 7.\)

Over the four cycles from \(2004\) to \(2020,\) the weekday advances \(4\cdot5=20\equiv 6\pmod 7,\) that is, \(6\) days forward, which is one day back from Sunday.

So Leap Day \(2020\) falls on a Saturday.

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Count the days from one Leap Day to the next: \(3\cdot365+366\)
That total is \(1461\equiv 5\pmod 7,\) so each \(4\)-year cycle advances the weekday by \(5\)
